# openxcvr-lib

> Rust library workspace for transceiver memory-map schemas, codegen, and multi-language bindings.

openxcvr-lib decodes SFF-8472 (SFP/SFP+), SFF-8636 (QSFP+/QSFP28) and CMIS memory maps and answers planning questions about a module. It parses and decides. The caller owns the bus.

## Repo entry points

- [README.md](README.md): project overview and a zero-setup run.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): how a change lands, including a public pull request.
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): what to report, and how.
